note: Ten desks: the existing news desk plus nine work desks. Official sources are primary or public records only (government, standards bodies, datasets with a named licence). The owner's own repositories and Learning Lab cards are listed under Experimental references, labelled 'Experimental (not an official source)', and never count as a record backing a claim. Atlas entries, news sections and episodes are GlobeDesk's own content (class internal), not sources. Withheld or private projects appear as 'owner project (link pending)' with no link. A desk with no official source shows official source [UNKNOWN] and is listed in atlas/OPEN-ITEMS.md. Depth labels come from the source inventory; anything a source does not label is [UNKNOWN].
